facts.fact: Arcep announced on 16 February 2024 the launch of phase 2 of the Universal Service of electronic communications, funded by a telecom-operator fund, to extend coverage to 200 villages in all nine provinces.
Arcep says phase 1 of the Universal Service (2016-2018) installed 18 radio stations benefiting 33 villages on the Makokou-Okondja and Okondja-Aboumi roads.
